content.title: Does God exist?
content.description: Compare arguments for God's existence with challenges to religious belief and its moral implications.

claim.text: Craig offers a cumulative case involving the universe, morality and Jesus. Hitchens challenges the case for theism and the character and effects of religion.

content.hinge: Does an objection to the conduct or desirability of religion address the argument for God's existence, and where does a philosophical case become specifically Christian?
prompts: Separate each claim from the evidence offered for it.
Identify which premise an objection challenges.
Ask what would remain if one argument failed.
